Metric schema 5: right = cameras' horizontal centres within 1.5 m of the reference (median) and <= 5 deg, <= 1.5 m over the wall points (90th pct, 3-D with the rotation from the cameras' orientations), <= 10 % scale. 2 repeats per building (metrics = median, noise = max-min). stylize on (its own time budget), keep_work_dirs. CORE FIVE only, as v0-baseline; left out: sagrada-familia, hungarian-parliament, lincoln-memorial, india-gate, sydney-opera-house (two repeats of the core five alone take about 5.5 h of COLMAP).
